characterPrompts.name: mascot-a
characterPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original Lime brand companion character, premium 3D mascot product render.
Input image 1 is a visual reference for the lime identity and friendly personality, not a layout to reproduce.
Primary request: redesign this cheerful lime pet to look more volumetric, more adorable, and professionally art-directed, retaining a recognizable lime-fruit identity. Original character; do not copy any existing company mascot.
Subject: a small plump lime sprite, a truly round spherical three-dimensional body rather than a flat coin, thick softly rounded lime-rind rim, a subtle segmented lime-flesh inset on the curved front, tiny pill-shaped arms, short chubby rounded feet with grounded weight, two sculptural plump fresh leaf sprouts. A large charming face, very glossy deep-green oval eyes with deliberate white catchlights, tiny soft smile, understated cream cheek highlights. Friendly, curious, reliable companion.
Materials: tactile translucent lime-green resin/jelly, clear depth through the body, gentle subsurface scattering, realistic refraction and internal pulp detail, finely dimpled peel, soft waxy leaves, smooth molded toy anatomy. Elegant highlights that describe the round silhouette. Not wet food, not photoreal citrus, not thin glass, not gummy slime.
Lighting: premium studio product photography, broad soft key light, subtle rim light, gentle ambient occlusion and a convincing soft contact shadow. Restrained warm white and pale sage backdrop, joyful calm mood. Very high-quality physically based 3D rendering, soft polished collectible toy.
Composition: one full-body mascot in a three-quarter view, ample clean breathing room on all sides, no cropping. The eyes must follow the body curvature. Strong recognizable silhouette at thumbnail size.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no logos, no watermark, no UI panels, no other characters, no dog or cat features, no sharp teeth, no scary expression, no checkerboard background. Keep the leaf crown and citrus identity.
Design direction: compact extra-plump body, little feet slightly apart, one tiny arm waving, a gentle head tilt. More physical thickness and soft rounded forms.
